name: Report of Suspected Child Abuse to ChildLine
description: Immediate electronic or oral report of suspected child abuse; an oral report must be followed by a written electronic report.
recipient: PA Department of Human Services (ChildLine / CWIS)
deadline: immediately; written electronic follow-up within forty-eight (48) hours after an oral report
quote: School employees, independent contractors or volunteers who suspect child abuse shall immediately make a written report of suspected child abuse using electronic technologies https://www.compass.state.pa.us/cwis/public/home or an oral report via the statewide toll-free telephone number, 1-800-932-0313.
